remarks: Discover a unique opportunity to live in a beautifully remodeled two-bedroom, one-bath top-floor home surrounded by gorgeously landscaped grounds. This spacious residence features an inviting living and dining area with large windows that fill the rooms with natural light. A generous private patio extends from the living room-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The apartment offers two well-proportioned bedrooms, including a walk-in closet, as well as gleaming hardwood floors and fresh paint throughout. The eat-in kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances. Nice full bath. Private, on-site parking for two vehicles is available and monitored by a surveillance system for your peace of mind. Additional personal storage space is available in the basement for extra. Conveniently located just minutes from vibrant downtown Norwalk and The SoNo Collection, this home combines comfort, style, and convenience in one exceptional package. Schedule your private showing and experience all this home has to offer!
